derivation: Generic structural choices for single-output combinational integer ALUs. Derived from the riscv_alu32 deterministic screen (adder sharing, shifter unification by bit reversal) plus common alternatives (merged right shifter, explicit log-stage shifters, output-select styles). Frozen before any held-out ALU is qualified; held-out sources were inspected only for interface/opcode compatibility.

addsub_share.rule: empty or at least two of the design's ops; members use one adder computing a + (b ^ {W{sub}}) + sub; non-members use their own native operator

shifter.rule: separate: one shifter per shift op; right_merged: SRL/SRA share an arithmetic right shifter with a fill bit; reverse_right: all shift ops use one arithmetic right shifter, SLL via bit reversal; reverse_left: all use one left shifter, right shifts via bit reversal and fill injection

shift_style.rule: native Verilog shift operators, or explicit log2(W) mux stages ordered from the least or most significant shift-amount bit

select.rule: case on the opcode; AND-OR of one-hot decoded results; or a per-class result (arith/logic/shift/compare) followed by a class select
